The points are \( \left( -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right) \) and \( \left( -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}, \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right) \). At these points, the value of \( |x| + |y| \) is also \( \sqrt{2} \).

Therefore, the largest possible value of \( |x| + |y| \) is \( \boxed{\sqrt{2}} \).
